_README: Edit the fields below, then run `python3 generate.py` from this folder. Everything in ../docs/ (the .vcf, both QR PNGs, and the web page) plus the Scriptable widget config is regenerated. Fields left blank are omitted from the vCard.
_base_url_note: The GitHub Pages URL where ../docs/ is published. The QR points at <base_url>/contact.vcf. Change this if you enable Pages on a different repo/branch or add a custom domain.
_phones_note: type is one of: cell, work, home. Add/remove entries freely.
_emails_note: type is one of: home, work.
_photo_note: Optional. A direct https URL to a square JPG/PNG (e.g. <base_url>/me.jpg after you drop me.jpg into ../docs/). Included in the hosted card only; never embedded in the QR itself.
